name: status-default-tier-node-backend
description: GET /status on the Node coordinator. The Node /status envelope is structurally different from Python's: {backend, counts, schema_version, status, version, coordinator_uptime_seconds, pre_edit_if_unheld, policy_summary, sessions, tracked_artifacts} vs Python's {coordinator_backend, detail, ...counters, tracked_artifacts, sessions, policy_summary}. This is a known wire-shape divergence, and this row pins the Node shape so any drift from it surfaces immediately. policy_summary.coordinator_root is the sentinel '.' as on the Python default tier (fixture 08): the Node coordinator publishes the absolute workspace root at no tier, its operator view included (fixture 42). pre_edit_if_unheld is true at every tier: the coordinator refuses a pre-edit sent with if_unheld: true while another session holds the file.
_comment: Cross-backend /status shape parity is a stretch goal tracked as AC-08 follow-up. v0.2 broad-beta launch ships with the divergence documented here in the corpus, the AC-09 README note, and the configuration.md operator guide. v0.3 should converge the shapes when the multi-target converter layer lands. schema_version tracks the Node SQLite registry schema: bumped 3→4 by SB-10 U5 (plugin migration v4, agent_states.last_observed_version), then 4→5 by the SB-10 perf follow-up (plugin migration v5, the agent_states(agent_id) index paired with Python v7). strict_mode_pattern_count joined the Node policy_summary with plugin #192, which matched the Python key set (fixture 08); like the other counts it is pinned at zero on an empty workspace. fold_profile and fold_table_unicode are ignored but kept in the body, so both keys stay required in this tier: the profile is whatever the disk under the run's tmp dir folds (caseless on a Mac, none on Linux CI), and the fold rows assert both fields per profile.
